_readme: Every line Panda says in the two rooms: the bedroom (/room.html) and the living room (Home, /living-room.html).
Edit freely; the pages read this file on load (no build step). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
Keep each line <= 96 characters (two dialog-box lines; longer ones log a warning in the browser console).
Use straight quotes: the PC-98 font draws curly ones full-width.
Doors (door_bedroom, door_outside) only have hover lines: clicking a door goes straight through it.
greeting: the opening box. hover: the line on pointing at an object. click: the box on first opening it this visit;
repeat: on opening it again. lines (on an object): what a no-link object says. choices: the menu after click
(label, and href or copy). lines (on a room): idle (after a while with no input), empty (clicking nothing), replies.
Living room only, for live state (the house's real devices): a variant per state, chosen by the page:
lamps: hover_on / hover_off / hover_unknown (feed down); lines, or lines_on / lines_off. {brightness} (percent),
{kelvin}, {warmth} (warm / soft white / daylight) fill in when the lamp is on.

tv: hover_off / hover_on (an idle screen) / hover_playing / hover_unknown; lines, lines_playing. While something plays, hover_episode ({show}, {episode}) or hover_show ({show}) when the app says what it is, else hover_playing.

speakers: hover_playing / hover_quiet / hover_unknown; lines, lines_playing. While music plays, hover_track ({title}, {artist}) or hover_title ({title}) when the app says what it is, else hover_playing.
kotatsu: hover_on / hover_off / hover_unknown (its plug); lines, lines_on.
thermostat: hover and lines may use {temp} (F), {heat} (on/off), {humidity}; hover_unknown when there's no reading.
blinds: hover_open / hover_partial / hover_closed / hover_unknown; {pct} (percent open) in hover_partial.
ac: hover_on ({mode}, {temp} its setpoint °F, {fan}) / hover_on_notemp / hover_off / hover_unknown; lines, lines_on.
Bedroom lines are adapted visual-novel lines; their sources: pc98-assets/assets/panda-room/dialogue-sources.md.

hints.otojima: Ever ridden the train from Platform 1 all the way to the end?
hints.gamecentre: See the TAITO sign on Isogashii Boulevard? That's not just a sign.
hints.ramen: Somewhere off the Alley there's a ramen stall. Follow your nose.

pick: "The music's too loud to hear anything, so just nod a lot."
"Regulars get a stamp card. You're not a regular. Yet."
"Confession: I can't actually make cocktails. I just shake things."

menu.label: Anything I can do?
say: "Actually, yeah. You going up Tokugawa Tower any time?"
"Give this to Tony at the bar. Don't read it. ...Okay, you can read it, it just says he's old."

menu.label: Ask about Tony
pick: "Tony taught me everything. Then I opened my own place, so now he pretends I don't exist."
"He sends a coaster back every time. Eight years. I have a whole drawer."

regular: (She stamps the last square and slides the card back.)
"Five! Congrats, anon. You're a regular now. Don't let it go to your head."

coaster.label: Give Sabrina Tony's coaster
say: She reads the coaster and snorts.
"'Still can't pour a straight line.' ...Tell him I'll pour HIM a straight line."
(She tucks the coaster in a drawer. It's full of coasters.)

sticker.label: Show Sabrina your purikura
say: "Ooh! Can I keep it? Look at Panda's bunny ears."
(She sticks it right on the register, next to a dozen others.)

camera.label: Show Sabrina your photos
say: "Ooh, the sunset at Otojima! I haven't been to the sea in years."
"Next time take me. ...Kidding. Unless?"

shell.label: Give Sabrina the seashell
say: "...From Otojima? You remembered." (She holds it up to her ear.)
"I can hear it. The sea. Don't tell anyone I got sentimental, anon."

greeting: "Hey, anon." (There's a little pink shell by the register now.)
"Oh, it's my favourite courier. What'll it be, anon?"

shizukastreet.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Ah, now we're exploring properly

sign_coffee.name: A sign
lines: COFFEE, and カフェ ノア: "Cafe Noa". Same people as the net cafe, I bet.

sign_slot.name: A sign
lines: スロット: "slots". A pachinko parlour. We are not going in there.

sign_karaoke.name: A sign
lines: カラオケ: "karaoke". There's a karaoke box behind the ramen stall, too.

linger: A bicycle bell dings somewhere behind you, and is gone.

weirdstore.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: This place is definitely a front for *something*

menu.label: Browse
pick: A jar labeled "misc." It's full of smaller jars.
A VHS tape called "Do Not Watch." The case says "Watch."
A skull keychain. It's smiling, which is worse.
A t-shirt that says "I survived" and nothing else.

menu.label: Ask for the second edition
say: The clerk looks up, then looks around.
"...Through the back. Wipe your feet."

backdoor.name: Staff door
lines: A door marked STAFF ONLY. It's locked. Or it's pretending to be.

livehouse.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Namba is the place to be for fun obscure music shows

menu.label: Request a song
say: You shout a request over the noise.

menu.label: Something nostalgic
say: They know this one! The whole room starts swaying.

menu.label: Something dizzy
say: The floor's spinning. Or maybe that's just the song.

menu.label: Something upbeat
say: The drummer grins. Finally, something fast.

menu.label: Whatever they were playing
say: Back to the set list.

greeting_thursday: Andy's on stage tonight! Facing the wall, as usual. The crowd loves it.

smallbathhouse.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Let's take a break and relax a while

menu.label: Have a soak
say: (You sink into the hot water up to your chin.)
(Your worries dissolve. Most of them.)

soak_token.label: Use Brownie's free-soak token
say: (You hand over the token and sink into the hot water.)
(A long time passes. Or a short one. It's hard to say.)
(When you get out, everything feels a little slower. In a good way.)

bathhouseentry.speaker: Brownie
greeting: "Welcome to my fine establishment, hope you enjoy yourself"

menu.label: Ask about the baths
pick: "Hottest water in the city. My grandfather dug the well himself."
"Towels are free. Rubber ducks are also free. Please return the rubber ducks."
"Some nights a black cat sneaks in to sleep by the boiler. I let it."

takeout.label: Give Brownie Taisho's ramen
say: "Oh, I'm not hungry." (Her stomach growls.) "...Fine. Tell Taisho thank you."
"Here. A free soak, on the house. Take your time in there."

greeting: "Welcome back! Tell Taisho his ramen was... adequate. Very adequate."

greeting_regular: "Back again? Your usual locker's free. I keep it free."

greeting: "Welcome to the Tokugawa tower sir, how may I assist?"

menu.label: Ask about the tower
pick: "Forty floors, sir. The bar is down here. The penthouse is for guests only."
"The elevator plays the same song every day. Guests have filed complaints. Lovingly."
"The penthouse is booked until further notice, sir. By a cat, oddly."

menu.label: Read the building directory
say: (The directory: B1 parking. 1F the bar. 40F the penthouse, guests only.)
"Floor 12 is METR, sir. They're often up late, measuring what AI systems can do."

menu.label: Take the lift
say: "Which floor, sir?"

menu.label: B1, parking
say: (The lift hums down. And down.)

menu.label: 1F, the bar
say: "Right this way, sir."

menu.label: 3F, the gallery
say: (The lift opens onto polished floors and very quiet people.)

menu.label: 40F, the penthouse
say: "Guests only, sir. ...I'll pretend I didn't see you."

menu.label: Ask 37 about his name
say: "Thirty-seven, sir. My mother had thirty-six names picked out. None of them stuck."
"Floor thirty-seven was empty when the tower opened. I took it as a sign."

penthouse.speaker: Ｐａｎｄａ
greeting: Looking out over the skyline always puts me in a contemplative mood...

menu.label: Sit and watch the city
pick: Way off past the park, little red lights. The festival's still going.
The last train's lights crawl out over the bridge, toward the sea.
Somewhere down there, a black cat is judging somebody.
Isogashii Boulevard never actually goes dark. Not once.

say: Lanterns, way past the park. Someone's winning at goldfish.
The harbour, right out at the edge. There's a light sweeping the water.
Someone's rooftop, with a folding chair aimed at the stars. Nice.
Through a window: a claw machine. The panda's still in there.
Way out past the harbour: the lighthouse. Flash. Six seconds. Flash.
A dome on the far hills, open to the sky. Someone else is looking up too.
A coin laundry, all lit up and empty. One machine's still going.
Steam over the Alley. Taisho's still open. Of course he is.

greeting_late: The city's quieter this late. Just the lights, and the hum.
linger: Far below, a train crawls across the city like a lit zip.

nightresidential_girl.speaker: Ｐａｎｄａ
greeting: Hey you don't think these people will mind us wandering into their houses right?

girl.name: The person on the street
click: "Uhh, that person is definitely a ghost. Let's not talk to them."

choices.label: Talk to her anyway
say: She doesn't look up. "I dropped my charm. Off the pier, years ago. I keep looking."
"I can't go anywhere without it."

choices.label: Talk to her anyway
say: "Still looking. It was red. A little shrine charm." She watches the street.

omamori.label: Give her the charm
say: She takes it in both hands. For the first time, she looks right at you.
"...Thank you."
When you look again, the street is empty. The streetlight hums.

greeting: The street's empty tonight. Someone's left a single flower by the wall.

towerbar.speaker: T o n y
greeting: "Come over here friend, grab yourself a seat!"

barshoujo.speaker: B a r s h o u j o
greeting: "Hey cutie, haven't seen you here before. Come share a drink with me"

menu.label: Order a drink
say: "What'll it be, friend?"

menu.label: Whisky, neat
say: "Good choice. I poured the good stuff. The boss can bill me."

menu.label: The house special
say: "A Tokugawa Sunset. Nobody knows what's in it. Including me."

menu.label: A glass of milk
say: "...Sure thing, friend. No judgment here."
(The whole bar goes quiet for a second.)

menu.label: Ask about the regulars
pick: "The fella in the hat? Been here since the tower opened. Never seen him leave."
"The lady in red tips great. Don't ask her what she does for a living."

menu.label: Ask about Sabrina
pick: "Best student I ever had. Worst listener. Don't tell her I said the first part."
"She runs a good bar. Too much grenadine, but a good bar."

menu.label: Ask about the empty stool
say: "Paid his tab, all twelve years of it. Said she'd finally come home."
"He left this. Said to give it to whoever helped her." (Tony slides over a hat.)

note.label: Give Tony Sabrina's note
say: Tony unfolds the note and laughs so loud the man in the hat looks up.
"Old! She calls ME old. I taught that kid to hold a shaker."
(He scribbles on a coaster and slides it over.) "Take that back down to her, would you?"

ace.label: Show the man in the hat Ruri's ace
say: The man in the hat looks at the ace for a long moment.
Then, very slowly, he tips his hat to you. He doesn't say a word.

camera.label: Show Tony your photos
say: "The view from the penthouse. Never been up. Forty years behind this bar."

greeting_late: "Pull up a stool, friend. Quiet tonight."
"The fella in the hat stepped out a minute ago. First time in twelve years."

greeting: The stool at the end of the bar is empty. For the first time in twelve years, Tony says.
"Back again, friend? She send another insult? ...Pull up a stool."

cat_visits: It's the cat from the old house! It blinks at you slowly, then trots off.
Mrrp. (The cat headbutts your leg and leaves. A visit, apparently.)
The cat again. It's definitely following us. Or we're following it.
konami: ...Did you just type the Konami code?
Fine. Thirty extra lives. Don't spend them all in one place.

ride: (A bus pulls up. No number, no destination on the front. The doors hiss open. You get on.)
(The driver doesn't look round. The city slides past the windows. Then the bus stops.)

festival.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Oh! So that's where the lanterns were coming from.

wataame.name: Cotton candy stall
click: Wataame! They'll spin it into whatever shape you ask for.

choices.label: Buy one
pick: You got a cat. It's mostly air. Perfect.
You asked for a cloud. It's very accurate.
You asked for a dragon. It's... dragon-ish.

yakisoba.name: Yakisoba stall
click: Yakisoba, sizzling away on a big iron plate.

choices.label: Get a plate
pick: Festival yakisoba beats every other yakisoba. I don't make the rules.
Extra pickled ginger. Good call.

goldfish.intro: Goldfish scooping! Three paper scoops, and the paper tears if you're rough with it.
goldfish.how: Click to dip the scoop, let go to lift it out. Gently!
result: The paper always tears. That's half the fun.
One goldfish! It gets its own little bag.
{n} goldfish! The stall owner looks nervous.

ringtoss.how: Ring toss! Three rings. Click (or Space) when the marker's over a bottle.
won: Two ringers! The stall keeper hands over a fox mask.
(It's a little too small. You wear it anyway.)
ringtoss.close: One ringer! So close. The stall keeper gives you a sympathetic nod.
ringtoss.none: Not one. The rings have a mind of their own.

menu.label: Buy taiyaki
say: "Which filling?"

menu.label: Red bean
say: (Crispy outside, sweet red bean all the way to the tail. The tail is the best part.)

menu.label: Custard
say: (Warm custard. You burn your tongue. Worth it.)

menu.label: Chocolate
say: (Chocolate taiyaki. Very modern. The fish looks proud of itself.)

menu.label: Try yo-yo fishing
say: (You fish for a water balloon with a paper hook. It holds! Just.)
You've got a water yo-yo. It goes boing.

greeting_halloween: A Halloween festival night! Half the kids here are dressed as goldfish.
greeting_winter: A winter festival! Amazake, hand warmers, and the goldfish tank's got a little heater.
linger: A kid walks past with a goldfish bag held up like a trophy.
rare: Someone's won the goldfish stall's grand prize: a goldfish the size of a cat. Chaos.

shrine.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A tiny shrine, all lit up for the festival.

offering.name: The shrine
click: An offering box, a bell rope, and a box of fortunes.

choices.label: Draw a fortune
pick: Great blessing! Whatever you lost will turn up somewhere silly.
Blessing. A good time to start something small.
Small blessing. Bring an umbrella.
Future blessing. Be patient with the slow ones, yourself included.
Middle blessing. Your next meal will be better than you expect.
Curse! Tie it to the rack so the bad luck stays here. Quick!

choices.label: Make a wish
say: (You toss in a coin, ring the bell, bow twice and clap twice.)
Don't tell me what you wished for. Then it won't come true.

fox_mask.label: Put on the fox mask
say: (You put on the fox mask.)
For a moment every lantern at the shrine flickers at once.
...Then the festival noise comes back. Did anyone else see that?

greeting_halloween: A jack-o'-lantern at a shrine. The gods don't seem to mind.

prompt: (You buy a little wooden plaque. Write your wish on it, then press Enter.)
hung: (You hang it on the rack with all the others. It clacks against its neighbours in the breeze.)
ema.still: Your ema's still on the rack, between a hundred others: "{wish}"

greeting_newyear: Hatsumode! The whole city's lined up for the year's first visit. Happy New Year.
greeting_winter: Snow on the shrine roof. The lanterns look even warmer.
greeting_spring: Petals all over the shrine steps. The bell rope's got one stuck to it.
linger: The bell rope sways. Nobody's touching it.

07-07: Tanabata! Bamboo by the shrine, covered in paper wishes. Somewhere up there, two stars meet.

backpassage.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: It squeezed down here. Is this even a street?

onigiri.label: Leave him the onigiri
say: You set the onigiri down next to him. One eye opens.
"...Thanks, kid. Here's one for free: the man in the hat? He's waiting for somebody."
"Same somebody, twelve years. Don't ask me who." (He's asleep again.)

play.cat_runs: There it goes again. It's leading us somewhere.
drifter: He mumbles in his sleep: "...ask Errata for the second edition..."
late_door: ...Was that door always there? There's a light on behind it.

greeting: The man from before is sitting up now. He nods at you. One crumb of onigiri left.

oldhouse.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: An old wooden house with the lights on.
The cat just walked right in like it owns the place.
greeting_rain: The rain's loud on the old roof tiles. The lights are still on inside.

catroom.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Nobody home but the cat. And somebody's tea is still warm...

cat.name: The cat
click: Curled up on the cushion like nothing happened.

mackerel.label: Give it the mackerel
say: The cat is awake before you've even unwrapped it.
(Crunch. Crunch. Crunch.)
It leaves something at your feet: a bottle cap. A gift!

goldfish_bag.label: Show it the goldfish
say: The cat's eyes go very, very wide.
...No. Absolutely not. The goldfish stays in its bag.

yoyo.label: Bounce the yo-yo for the cat
say: The cat watches the yo-yo go up and down, up and down, without moving its head.
Then it swats it once, decisively, and goes back to sleep.

tea.name: Tea
lines: A teapot and two cups. One's still warm. Someone just stepped out.
note: A teapot and two cups. Under one cup, a note:
"Gone to the stall. If the cat says it hasn't eaten, it's lying. -T"

tv.name: TV
lines: The TV's warm too. Somebody was watching the late movie.

daruma.name: Daruma
lines: A little red daruma, keeping watch.

scroll.name: Scroll
lines: A calligraphy scroll. Very confident brushwork.

window.name: Window
lines: The garden's out there, all dark. Something rustles.

pets: It stretches one paw out. Purrrrrr.
It rolls onto its back. This is a trap, isn't it.
SWAT. Yep. It was a trap.
pets_fed: Purrrr. It pushes its head into your hand.
It rolls over. You know this trick. ...It's not a trick this time.
It falls asleep with its paw on your hand. You live here now, apparently.

greeting_late: The tea's gone cold. The cat hasn't moved an inch.

greeting: The cat opens one eye when you come in, then closes it again. You're allowed.

linger: The cat snores, very quietly. Then louder. Then very quietly again.

otojima.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Otojima! Last stop. Smell that? Sea air.

menu.label: Check the timetable
pick: One train a day, it says. It's always the one you just missed.
The timetable has a doodle of a fish in the corner. It's waving.

surfshop.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A surf shop that also sells snowboards. Covering all the bases.

shop.name: Half Pipe
click: Boards, wax, and a whole wall of keychains.

choices.label: Buy a souvenir
pick: A keychain shaped like a tiny surfboard. Essential.
A shell necklace. Very authentic. Made in Ohio.
A postcard of this exact shop. Very meta.

menu.label: Buy a disposable camera
say: You buy a disposable camera. Twenty-four shots. Choose wisely.
(Somewhere pretty would be good. A sunset, maybe.)

beach.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The beach! Somebody left a drink on the table...

drink.name: A drink
click: It has a tiny umbrella in it.

choices.label: Take a sip
say: ...Coconut. Whoever ordered this has great taste.

chair.name: Beach chair
lines: The most important piece of furniture ever invented.

sea.name: The sea
lines: The water's warm. Mostly.

menu.label: Look for shells
say: (You walk along the tideline. Mostly seaweed. Then: a perfect little pink shell.)

menu.label: Build a sandcastle
cycle: (You build a sandcastle. A wave takes it. Rude.)
(Bigger this time. A moat, even. A wave takes it.)
(You build it further up the beach. It survives. You are victorious.)

linger: A wave comes up further than the others and just touches your shoes.
rare: Way out past the waves, something huge surfaces and blows. A whale! Then it's gone.

sunset.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: We stayed out until the sun went down. Worth it.

sun.name: The sun
lines: Don't stare at it. ...Okay, maybe a little.

harbour.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The harbour at night. There's a little boat that goes upriver.

fishing.cast: (You cast off the end of the pier. Now you wait.)
fishing.too_soon: Too soon! Whatever it was, it's gone.

say: A mackerel! A good fat one. You wrap it up. Somebody might want it.
release: Another mackerel. You've already got one, so this one goes back.

say: A tiny crab. It pinches the line and lets go. Rude.
An old boot. Classic.
A squid! It squirts ink at you and plops back in.
An octopus. It waves. You wave back.
A message in a bottle!
A fish that looks exactly like Johnny Uppercut. You don't tell him.
Something red, tangled in the line... a little shrine charm. Old, but it's not even wet.

linger: A boat's rope creaks against the pier. Somewhere, a gull complains.
rare: A huge cruise ship slides past the harbour mouth, lit up like a city of its own.

riverboat.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Wait, it's daytime again?
...I've stopped asking questions about this city.

zengarden.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: ...A garden? THIS is what it was a front for?
Honestly? Fair enough.

teahouse.name: Teahouse
click: There's a kettle on in the teahouse.

choices.label: Have a cup
say: (You sit on the step and sip. It's bitter, then sweet.)

bridge.name: Bridge
lines: An old stone bridge. Someone's worn a dip into the middle of it.

pond.name: Koi pond
click: Koi! The orange ones are definitely judging us.

choices.label: Feed them
pick: They swarm. The big white one wins, as usual.
One of them blows a bubble at you. Thanks?

goldfish_bag.label: Let your goldfish go in the koi pond
say: You open the bag at the water's edge. Your goldfish hesitates, then darts in.
Three koi the size of your arm come to look. It stares them down. They leave.

play.sit: (You sit by the water. Nobody says anything for a while.)

greeting: The garden again. Your goldfish is in the koi pond, small, orange, bossing everyone around.

linger: A frog plops into the pond. The koi pretend not to notice.

ramen.speaker: T a i s h o
greeting: "Irasshai! Sit, sit. Cold night for it."

lantern.name: Lantern
lines: The lantern says "ramen." It has never needed to say anything else.

stools.name: Stools
lines: Three stools. The middle one wobbles. Everyone knows not to take it.

sign_ramen.name: A sign
lines: ラーメン: "ramen". The whole alley agrees on this.

sign_cashier.name: A sign
lines: カシアリ: "cashiari". It's somebody's name. Or a typo. Probably both.

sign_ramen2.name: A sign
lines: ラーメン again. Two ramen signs in one alley. Bold strategy.

menu.label: Order ramen
say: "What'll it be?"

menu.label: Shoyu
say: "Shoyu. A classic."
(It's perfect. You drink the broth too. He nods, approving.)

menu.label: Miso
say: "Miso! Good on a cold night."
(The steam fogs up everything for a second.)

menu.label: Whatever you recommend
say: "Tonkotsu. Twelve hours on the stove."
"If you don't like it, don't tell me."

menu.label: Ask about Panda
pick: "Panda? Comes by after midnight. Writes down everything I say, like it's a recipe."
"Panda always orders the same thing, then asks how I made it. Every time."
"Says it all goes in a book. Don't know who'd want to read about my broth."

menu.label: Ask about the other regular
say: "Panda's husband? Comes in with Panda. Takes notes on everything, same as Panda."
"They sit right there and compare notes over the broth. Venki, his name is."

menu.label: Ask about the old house
say: "The old wooden house? With the cat?" (He laughs.)
"That's mine. Well. The cat lets me stay there."
"Leave the door open for me? The cat can't work the latch. Says it can, but it can't."

menu.label: Anything I can do?
say: "You know Brownie, at the bathhouse? She forgets to eat during the evening rush."
"Take her this. Shoyu, extra egg. She'll pretend she isn't hungry."

menu.label: Find Panda's recipe book
say: "The book? Round the corner. Tell 'em Taisho sent you."

mackerel.label: Give Taisho the mackerel
say: "Ho! Fresh off the pier?"
(He grills it right there with a pinch of salt. Shioyaki. It's perfect.)
"The cat from the old house would've fought you for that."

panda.label: Show Taisho the panda plush
say: "Ha! It looks just like Panda. Same face when the ramen's late."

camera.label: Show Taisho your photos
say: "The roof of the apartments? I can see my house from there. Well. The cat's house."

greeting_late: "Still up? Good. The broth's best this late."
greeting_rain: "Get under the awning! Rain makes the broth taste better, you know."

greeting: "Brownie ate it all, didn't she? She always says she's not hungry. Irasshai!"

greeting_winter: "In you come, out of the snow! Ramen weather, this."
greeting_regular: "Ah, my regular! Sit, sit. The usual's already on."
linger: Taisho hums an old song while he stirs. He's out of tune. It's perfect.

12-31: "Toshikoshi soba tonight, not ramen! Long noodles, long life. Sit, sit."

gamecentre.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A game centre! Oh no. Oh no, look at the claw machine.

cabinets.name: Arcade cabinets
lines: Someone's high score here is 999,999. I refuse to believe it.

cabinets2.name: Arcade cabinets
lines: A fighting game, mid-demo. The characters are just standing there, waiting for us.

intro: There's a panda in there. Look at it. It needs us.
claw.how: Move the claw with the pointer (or arrow keys). Click (or Space) to drop it.
claw.done: Out of tries. The claw machine wins this round.

pose: You squeeze into the photo booth. Three, two, one... peace sign!
printed: (A sheet of stickers slides out. You look great. Panda's doing bunny ears.)

rooftop.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The roof! You can actually see stars from up here.
Watch long enough and one might fall.

laundry.name: Laundry
click: Someone's towels. And, pegged on the end all by itself, a single sock.

tank.name: Water tank
lines: The water tank hums to itself.

chair.name: Folding chair
lines: A folding chair pointed right at the sky. Somebody comes up here a lot.

play.no_star: Just stars, sitting still. Keep watching.
wishes: Quick, make a wish! ...Did you get it in?
Got it! That one was a big one.
third_wish: The universe owes you, now. Spend them wisely.

greeting_late: The roof at this hour. Even the city's asleep. Mostly.

menu.label: Take down the lone sock
say: (You unpeg the sock. It's been up here a while. It looks lonely.)

menu.label: Watch the fireworks with everyone
say: You've found every corner of Pandopolis. So, one by one, the town comes up to the roof.
Taisho brings a pot of broth and too many bowls. "Eat, eat. It's a long night."
Sabrina and Tony share the railing. "Still can't pour," he says. She laughs anyway.
Andy turns all the way around to watch the sky. Sakura looks very smug about it.
Brownie hands out towels, for some reason. Ruri is already winning at cards with 37.
Johnny watches from the stairs. "Information's free tonight, stranger."
The cat sits on the water tank like it owns the building. It probably does.
Up over the skyline, the festival's last fireworks go off, one after another.
Thanks for visiting Pandopolis. Come back any time. The city will keep the lights on.

greeting_winter: Snow on the roof, and on the folding chair. Somebody brushed off half of it.
linger: The city hums below. Somewhere a window goes dark, then another lights up.
rare: A meteor shower! One, two, five, too many to count. Make a wish? Make all of them.

08-12: The Perseids peak tonight. The sky's full of shooting stars. Make all the wishes.

konbini.speaker: C a s h i e r
greeting: "Irasshaimase! Welcome!"

menu.label: Buy an onigiri
say: "Which filling?"

menu.label: Salmon
say: "Salmon! A solid choice." (You tuck it in your pocket for later.)

menu.label: Tuna mayo
say: "Tuna mayo. The people's champion."

menu.label: Umeboshi
say: "Pickled plum? Brave. It's very sour."

menu.label: Get some oden
say: "Daikon, egg, and... konnyaku? Coming right up."
(It's the warmest thing in the whole city right now.)

menu.label: Ask about the night shift
pick: "Night shift's quiet. Except for a black cat that comes in to sit by the heater."
"A man in a hat buys one melon bread every night at three. Never says a word."
"Somebody from the tower bar comes in for milk. Asked me not to tell anyone. Oops."

menu.label: Read Panda's column
say: (Page six of the Times: a column by Panda, called "The Portal". It's long. It's good.)

greeting_late: (A man in a hat brushes past on his way out. A melon bread under one arm.)

greeting: "Irasshaimase! ...You're out late a lot, huh? Same."
"Irasshaimase! ...Funny. The man in the hat didn't come in for his melon bread."

intro: (You flip through the Pandopolis Times at the magazine rack.)

headlines.text: CITY: Isogashii Boulevard voted "most likely to be awake" for the 40th year.
WEATHER: Rain, probably. Then not. Then rain.
LOCAL: Shizuka Street pachinko parlour denies being "too loud". Loudly.
SPORTS: Salarymen at Izakaya Gonta still arguing about last week's game.
ARTS: Tokugawa Gallery's dot painting "Commute" baffles critics, delights commuters.
LOCAL CAT ADOPTS VISITOR. "It was the mackerel," sources say.
ANDY TURNS AROUND. Musician seen facing his audience for first time.
MAN IN HAT LEAVES BAR. Twelve-year tab settled in full.
BARTENDERS RECONCILE? Tower Bar and Rabu Rabu "definitely not friends," both insist.
BATHHOUSE OWNER EATS DINNER. Neighbours relieved.
LONE SOCKS REUNITED AT COIN LAUNDRY. "A miracle," says dryer.
STREETLIGHT ON THE RESIDENTIAL STREET "less lonely somehow," say residents.
VISITOR'S PHOTOGRAPHS ON SHOW at the Tokugawa Gallery. Four people attend.
NET CAFE REPORTS "ghost post" on old forum. Staff unbothered.
KOI POND UNDER NEW MANAGEMENT. Small orange fish in charge, say sources.
RABU RABU REGISTER DISPLAYS SEASHELL. Owner "not sentimental".
WHITE FOX SIGHTED AT HILL GATES. Shrine says: "of course."
MYSTERY POET UNMASKED? Bookshop declines to comment.

greeting_regular: "Oh, hi again! I put the good onigiri aside for you. Employee privileges."
linger: The door chime goes. Nobody's there. It does that sometimes.
rare: "Irasshaimase!" (The cashier is wearing a full dinosaur costume. Nobody explains why.)

bookshop.speaker: B o o k s e l l e r
greeting: "Open till the last train. Mind the stacks."

menu.label: Read the poem by the till
Ask what Panda's reading
say: "Panda? Keeps a list. I'll show you."

menu.label: Ask who writes the poems
say: "My niece. She sits down by the river and counts the shrine petals."
"Don't tell her I told you. She'd stop writing them."

play.recommend: "Panda gave this one five stars: {title}, by {author}. Couldn't stop talking about it."
play.no_books: "The shelves are being restocked. Come back later?"
poem_intro: (A card by the till, in the bookseller's handwriting: tonight's poem.)
poems: Last train gone. / The platform keeps / its yellow line / for no one.
Two forks, one cake. / The window fogs. / Outside, the rain / pretends not to look.
A cat on the water tank / counts the city's lights / and loses track / on purpose.
Steam off the broth, / steam off the bath: / the whole town / breathing out.
The lighthouse says / the same word every six seconds. / The sea / never tires of it.
Neon in the puddle. / You step over it / carefully, / like it might wake.
Somebody's laundry / turning in the dark. / Two socks, / finding each other.
Paper lanterns / far back in the trees. / The festival / you can almost hear.
Three in the morning. / The net cafe clock agrees. / It always / agrees.
The moon tonight / is only a fingernail. / Still, / it finds the river.
Ramen, a warm bath, / and someone / to walk you home. / That's the whole list.
The man in the hat / ordered one more, / and the glass / waited with him.

aquarium.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: An aquarium, open at night! Look up. Jellyfish.

bench.name: Bench
click: A bench in the middle of the tunnel. Perfect for staring at fish.

choices.label: Sit and watch
pick: A fish swims right up to the glass and stares back. You lose.
The jellyfish don't do anything. That's what's great about them.
Somewhere above you, the sea keeps going for miles.

ray.name: Ray
lines: A ray glides overhead like it's showing off. It is.

goldfish_bag.label: Show your goldfish the aquarium
say: You hold the bag up to the glass.
Your goldfish stares at the big fish going past. Aspirational.

menu.label: Press your hand to the glass
cycle: (The glass is cold. A little fish swims up to your hand and stays.)
(The ray glides over, close enough to see its smile. Rays always look like they're smiling.)
(A jellyfish drifts past your fingers, slow as breathing.)

linger: A jellyfish drifts up and bumps the glass right in front of you. Hello.

netcafe.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Net Cafe Noa. Open all night.
In here it's always three in the morning.

booth.name: A booth
click: This booth's computer is still logged in. The bookmarks are... mine?

choices.label: Read the old posts
say: Dollars BBS. I posted here when I was sixteen.
The account's still logged in. Past me had a LOT of opinions about anime.

click_late: The screen flickers. For a second, in big letters: PRESENT DAY. PRESENT TIME.
...Then the bookmarks are back, like nothing happened.

drinkbar.name: Drink bar

You fill the cup to the very top. Nobody's watching.

choices.label: Corn soup

Perfect.

manga.name: Manga shelves

clock.name: Clock

greeting_late: Net Cafe Noa at an actual three in the morning. It feels right.

forestpath.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: It's quiet up here. Just birds, and the light coming down through the trees.

teaparty.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A table set for tea, in the middle of the woods. Nobody around.

table.name: Tea table
click: Four chairs, one teapot. The tea's still warm. Again.

choices.label: Pour a cup
say: (You pour a cup and sit for a minute. A bird lands on the next chair.)
...It doesn't want any. Fair.

menu.label: Wait to see who comes back
say: (You wait. The tea goes cold.)
(A rabbit hops out of the bushes, looks at you, looks at the table, and leaves.)
...Well. That answers that.

hilltop.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The whole valley! You can see all the way to the mountain.

view.name: The view
lines: Fields, a little road, a mountain. The city feels very far away.

kids.name: Kids
lines: Some kids are chasing a red ball down the hill. One of them waves.

menu.label: Sit under the tree for a while
cycle: (You sit with your back against the tree. The wind moves the grass in long waves.)
(A train crosses the valley far below, small as a toy. You can just hear it.)
(The kids' red ball bounces past. One of them chases it, waving sorry.)
(You watch the shadow of a cloud slide all the way across the valley.)
(You don't think about anything for a while. It's nice.)

linger: The kids' red ball rolls past your feet. One of them waves sorry.

lilyfield.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A whole field of red spider lilies.
They only bloom for a week or two. We got lucky.

lilies.name: Spider lilies
lines: Higanbana. They come up all at once, like someone flipped a switch.

menu.label: Walk through the lilies
say: (You walk the narrow path between them. They come up to your knees.)
Higanbana are supposed to grow along the way to the other side. This one's very pretty.

campsite.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: It got dark while we walked. Someone's got a campfire going.

fire.name: Campfire
lines: Warm. The sparks go up and up and don't come back.

campers.name: Two travellers
click: Two travellers. One's asleep. One's poking the fire with a stick.

choices.label: Sit by the fire
say: (You sit. The fire pops. Nobody says anything, and that's fine.)

choices.label: Ask where they're headed
pick: "Wherever the path goes," she says. "It always comes out somewhere."
"Down to the glade, then the city. No hurry."

linger: The fire pops. The sleeping one mumbles something about pancakes.

laundromat.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A coin laundry. Two in the morning energy, whatever the time is.

machine.name: A machine, going
click: Someone's laundry, going round and round. Nobody's here to collect it.

choices.label: Watch it spin
say: (You watch it go round. And round. And round.)
...That was weirdly relaxing.

machines.name: Washing machines
lines: A wall of washing machines, all waiting. Two hundred yen a load.

vending.name: Vending machine
click: Hot drinks in cans.

choices.label: Hot milk tea
say: (The can's almost too hot to hold. Perfect.)

choices.label: Corn potage
say: Corn soup. In a can. From a machine. Japan, I love you.

chairs.name: Chairs
click: Plastic chairs and a stack of very old magazines.

choices.label: Read a magazine
pick: A fashion magazine from 1998. Everyone's wearing very small sunglasses.
A manga anthology with the last page torn out. Of course.
A crossword, half done in pen. Seven down is 'cat'. It's always cat.

choices.label: Just sit
say: (You sit. The machine hums. Somewhere, a dryer buzzes.)

sock.name: A sock
lines: A single sock. Its partner is out there somewhere. They'll find each other.

say: You set the rooftop sock down next to the lone one.

(Somewhere, a dryer buzzes, like applause.)

garage.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The tower's car park. It's very quiet down here. Too quiet?

bluecar.name: A dark blue car
lines: A dark blue car. The engine's still warm.
On the seat, a hat-shaped dent. On the dashboard, a melon bread wrapper.

redcar.name: A maroon car
lines: A maroon sports car. There's a parking ticket on it dated 1997.

greeting: The dark blue car's still parked here. The engine's cold now, for the first time.

cardroom.speaker: R u r i
greeting: "Well, well. Lost, kid? Or looking for a game?"

"Johnny and I go way back. He owes me. Everyone in this town owes me."
"The man in the hat plays here Tuesdays. Never takes the hat off. Never loses."

won: "Three in a row. Fine." (She flicks you a card.) "Keep the ace. You'll need it."

gallery.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The tower has an art gallery on floor three. Open late, for some reason.

dots.name: Painting of dots
lines: Seven coloured dots on white. The card says it's called 'Commute'.

nude.name: A landscape
lines: A long, warm landscape. Sand, maybe. Or a person sleeping. Hard to say.

ufo.name: Painting of a UFO
lines: A UFO over a mountain. The card says 'Self Portrait'.

lines: Blown up so big it's mostly grain. You have to stand way back to see it.

visitors.name: Visitors
lines: A couple, holding hands, very quietly having an opinion.

...Some of it looks a lot like this city.

exhibition: A new show: "Pandopolis at Night, by an anonymous visitor." Wait. These are yours.
(A couple stops at one of your photos for a long time. They seem to like it.)

izakaya.speaker: G o n t a
greeting: "IRASSHAIIII! Sit down, sit down! First one's on me!"

salarymen.name: Salarymen

(The whole bar gets a piece. The salarymen stop arguing to applaud.)

greeting_regular: "MY FAVOURITE CUSTOMER! Your seat's been waiting! Nobody else is allowed in it!"

nightcafe.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A little cafe, still open. Two people in the window, sharing a slice of cake.

He's facing her. Actually facing someone. Good for him.

window.name: The window
click: Warm light, two coffees, one slice of cake, two forks.

choices.label: Wave

02-14: Valentine's Day. Every table in the cafe has two forks and one slice of cake.

choices.label: An anime opening

(Shk-shk-shk!) Somewhere, a ramen chef nods along.

lake.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The boat stops at a lake under the mountain. A ferry's crossing, very slowly.

flowers.name: Wildflowers
lines: Little pink flowers all along the fence. Somebody planted these. Or nobody did.

tree.name: A big tree
lines: A huge old tree, leaning out over the water like it's thinking about swimming.

menu.label: Watch the ferry
say: (It takes the ferry a long time to get anywhere. Nobody on it seems to mind.)

greeting: An old observatory up on the ridge. The dome's open, and somebody left the lamp on.

click: A big brass telescope, already pointed at the sky.

desk.name: Desk
click: A lamp, a thermos of tea, and a notebook of observations.

cycle: "Clear skies. Saw Jupiter's moons. All four. Waved."
"Cloudy. Drank the tea instead."
"A shooting star over the apartments. Somebody on the roof saw it too."
"The festival fireworks again. Couldn't see anything else. Didn't mind."

choices.label: Have some tea

dipper: The Big Dipper! Seven stars, one very large ladle.
cat: ...It's a cat. Somebody drew a cat in the stars. The chart calls it "Neko Major".
panda: A panda! The little doodle on the chart was right. It really is up there.

nighttrain.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The last train back to the city. Nobody else on board.
The town lights go by, one after another.

seat.name: Seat
click: The seats are warm from the heater underneath.

choices.label: Sit by the window
cycle: (You watch the lights go by. A level crossing dings, and is gone.)
(Your reflection floats over the dark fields. It looks sleepy.)
(A lit window: someone cooking a late dinner. Then trees.)
(You almost fall asleep. The train sways you awake.)

linger: Someone left yesterday's paper on the seat. The crossword's finished, in pen.

lighthouse.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: The top of the lighthouse. Just the sea, the stars, and the lamp turning behind us.

lamp.name: The lamp
lines: The lens is as big as a car. It turns so slowly you can only tell by the flash.

town.name: The town
lines: Otojima's lights, small as a toy town. The aquarium's still lit up.

sea.name: The sea
lines: Out there, past where the light reaches, the sea just keeps going.

menu.label: Lean on the rail for a while
cycle: (The wind smells like salt. The lamp hums.)
(A fishing boat's lights crawl along the horizon.)
(You count the seconds between flashes. Six. Always six.)
(The stars here are brighter than anywhere in the city.)

menu.label: Read the keeper's logbook
cycle: "Clear night. The riverboat late again. Captain blames the ferry. The ferry blames no one."
"Fireworks over the city at eleven. The festival must be on. Wish I could hear it."
"Someone fishing off the pier at 2am. Caught a boot. Kept fishing. Respect."
"The aquarium's lights stayed on all night again. I think the jellyfish like it."
"A red charm in the water by the pier, years ago now. I never could reach it."
"Six seconds. Six seconds. Six seconds. Forty years, and it's never once been seven."

linger: Flash. Six seconds. Flash. You've started counting along without meaning to.

bar25.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A tiny bar with no sign. It's very quiet in here. Even the city sounds far away.

bartender.name: Bartender
click: He's polishing a glass that's already clean.

choices.label: Ask what this place is
say: "Bar 25. We're open from two until four."
"Or until you don't need us anymore. Whichever comes first."

choices.label: Order something

menu.label: A Lighthouse
say: (Something clear and cold, with a single cherry that catches the light every few seconds.)

menu.label: The Last Train
say: (Dark, warm, a little sweet. You feel like you could sleep for a week.)

menu.label: Three in the Morning
say: (It's just coffee. "Everyone needs one at some point," he says.)

menu.label: Something for the road
say: (He pours you a glass of water and slides it over. "Go home safe.")
"Everything's named after somewhere in the city. Pick a place."

choices.label: Ask about the man in the hat
say: "Him. He used to come in here with a girl, years ago. She'd talk his ear off."
"Then one night she didn't come. After that, neither did he. He drinks at the tower now."

choices.label: Ask about the man in the hat
say: "He came in last night. First time in twelve years. No hat."
"He sat right there and smiled at nothing. I didn't charge him."

lady.name: The lady in red
click: The lady in red from the tower bar, resting her head on her arms.

choices.label: Say hello
say: "The tower's too loud after midnight. I come here to hear myself think."

choices.label: Say hello
say: "Did you hear? The man in the hat finally left. Good for him."
"Twelve years. Some people wait a long time to go home."

linger: The bartender polishes the same glass. It's been very clean for a while now.

underbridge.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Steps down from the shrine to the river. Somebody's sitting by the water.

girl.name: A girl by the river
click: She's hugging her knees, watching the water. She doesn't seem to mind company.

choices.label: Sit with her
say: "The petals come down from the shrine. I count them. Two hundred and six tonight."

choices.label: Ask if she writes the poems
say: She goes very still. "...You read one? The card by the till?"
"My uncle pins them up. I didn't think anybody actually read them."
(She looks pleased, and then hides it.)

river.name: The river
lines: Petals drifting on black water, all heading the same way. Out to sea, eventually.

play.your_wish: "Sometimes an ema floats down. One came by tonight. It said: '{wish}'."
hope: "I hope it comes true. I always hope they come true."
no_wish: "Sometimes a wish floats down from the shrine. You can read them, if you're quick."
"Nobody's sent one tonight. Maybe you should."

greeting: She's writing something in a little notebook. She covers it when she sees you, smiling.

linger: She hums something under her breath. The river carries it off.

inari.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: Red gates, hundreds of them, climbing up the hill into the dark.
Two stone foxes keep watch at the bottom.

fox_l.name: Stone fox
lines: A stone fox in a red bib, ears up, listening for something far up the hill.

fox_r.name: Stone fox
lines: The other fox, the same red bib. Its eyes follow you. Probably not.

menu.label: Count the gates
say: (You start counting. You lose count somewhere past two hundred.)
They say nobody's ever counted the same number twice.

fox_mask.label: Put on the fox mask
say: (You put on the fox mask.)
...Between the gates, something moves. A real fox, white as paper, sitting on the path.
It looks at you, then at the mask, then bows its head once. When you blink, it's gone.

catcafe.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: A cat cafe! Six cats, zero interest in us. Perfect.
A cat cafe! ...Wait, that black cat by the counter. It's ours. It visits, apparently.

calico.name: Calico
click: A calico on the very top of the cat tower, surveying her kingdom.

choices.label: Pet
pick: She allows exactly one pat. Then she turns her back. Audience over.
She headbutts your hand. You have been chosen.

grey.name: Grey tabby
click: A grey tabby on the shelf, pretending to be a bookend.

choices.label: Pet
pick: He doesn't move a muscle. Purring, though. Definitely purring.
He knocks a book off the shelf, looking right at you.

smallginger.name: Little ginger
click: A little ginger cat curled on a cushion on the shelf, one eye open.

choices.label: Pet
pick: Mew. (It's very small. Your heart can't take it.)
It attacks your sleeve with its whole body. Ferocious.

ginger.name: Ginger
click: A big ginger cat flat out on a cushion, belly to the ceiling.

choices.label: Pet
pick: You touch the belly. Big mistake. Huge. (It was worth it.)
He stretches so long he's twice the size. Then flops back.

white.name: White cat
click: A white cat mid-stretch, back legs out, very serious about it.

choices.label: Pet
pick: She finishes the stretch first. Then accepts pets. Priorities.
Mrrp? She follows you for exactly three steps, then forgets.

cream.name: Fluffy cream
click: A cloud of cream fur asleep in the toy basket. There's a cat in there somewhere.

choices.label: Pet
pick: Your hand disappears into the fluff. The fluff purrs.
It sneezes in its sleep. Somewhere, angels weep.

menu.label: Order a cat-shaped latte
say: (The foam is a cat face. You can't bring yourself to drink it. ...You drink it.)

You are, briefly, the most popular person in Pandopolis.

yoyo.label: Bounce the water yo-yo
say: Six heads follow the yo-yo up and down. The kitten falls off the shelf. It's fine.

pier.speaker: P a n d a
greeting: An old amusement pier, all lit up. The rides are still turning, even with nobody here.

wheel.name: Ferris wheel
click: The Ferris wheel turns so slowly you could step right into a gondola.

carousel.name: Carousel
click: A little carousel, horses going up and down to a tinny waltz.

pick: (You pick the white horse. Round and round. You're grinning. You can't stop.)
(You pick the one with the chipped ear. It seems grateful.)

booth.name: Ticket booth
lines: The ticket booth is lit, but nobody's in it. A sign says "Honour system".

letters._readme: Letters that arrive in the living room after you've helped someone in Explore (need: the flag). js/house-key.js.

text: A postcard from Rabu Rabu: "Thanks for playing courier, anon. Tony says hi. (He didn't.)"
A guitar pick taped to a note: "thx for the fuse. Namba Bears, thursday. -andy"
A bathhouse ticket and a note: "Taisho's ramen was excellent. I'll deny saying so. -B"
An envelope with nothing in it but a pressed red flower. No name. You know who it's from.
Not a letter. A single grey feather, left on the doormat. The cat says thank you.
A note in very neat handwriting: "He tipped his hat? In twelve years... Who ARE you? -J"
No stamp, no name. Just: "Thank you for bringing her home. -H"
A Rabu Rabu napkin: "Still listening to the shell. It says hi. -S"
No envelope. Just a single white hair on the doormat, and the faint smell of incense.
A postcard of Otojima beach. On the back, in your own handwriting: "Wish you were here."
A playing card, the two of hearts. On the back: "Rematch. Tuesday. Bring luck. -R"
A grease-spotted note: "If you see the cat, tell it dinner's at nine. It won't listen. -T"
A matchbook from Bar 25. Inside: "Open two till four. Or whenever you need us."
A note in very careful brushwork: "Your fish has taken over the pond. We approve. -the garden"
